purpose: A menu of commands with arrow keys, typeahead, checkbox and radio items and submenus, following the WAI-ARIA menu pattern.

supplied: the menu pattern: role=menu with menuitem, menuitemcheckbox and menuitemradio children
arrow keys move, typeahead jumps to a matching item, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger
submenus open on ArrowRight and close on ArrowLeft
a disabled item stays focusable so it can be read, and is not activated
required: an accessible name on the trigger when it is an icon
`destructive` on items that delete, so they are not styled as ordinary commands

composition.notes: A menu holds commands, not fields. The roving focus of the menu pattern and a text field's own key handling cannot both own the arrow keys.

safeMutations.rationale: Placement and ornament are safe. `onSelect` is the command itself, and `destructive` is a warning an agent must not remove.

propNotes.shortcut: Displayed only. The component does not bind the key; the application does.
propNotes.destructive: Styles the item as dangerous. Remove it only if the item stops being dangerous.
